notify.local.purpose: Remind you when a task is due, with Done and Snooze buttons

widget.home.purpose: Show today’s tasks on your home screen so you can tick them off there

files.io.purpose: Import tasks from a CSV file and export your tasks to a file you choose

dataFlows.purpose: Your tasks and lists, saved as a CSV file where you choose, as a backup or to move them

dayReminder.label: Remind me of tasks without a time

digest.label: Morning summary of today’s tasks
digest.help: One notification with what is due today and what is overdue, sent only when there is something.

list.help: Leave it empty to keep the task in your Inbox

dueTime.label: Time
dueTime.help: Without a time the task is due any time that day

checks.message: Pick a due date for a repeating task.

remind.label: Remind me
remind.help: At the due time, or at your daily reminder time when the task has no time

dueLabel.label: Due
dueLabel.compute: =!has(item.due) ? '' : coalesce(item.due == today() ? 'Today' : item.due == addDays(today(), 1) ? 'Tomorrow' : item.due == addDays(today(), -1) ? 'Yesterday' : formatDate(item.due, 'MMMEd'), '') + (has(item.dueTime) ? ', ' + coalesce(formatDate(item.dueTime, 'jm'), '') : '')

summary.label: Summary
summary.compute: =join([item.dueLabel, has(item.repeat) ? formatRecurrence(item.repeat) : '', coalesce(item.list.name, 'Inbox'), size(item.steps) > 0 ? t('stepsDone', {'done': item.stepsDone, 'total': size(item.steps)}) : ''].filter(s, s != ''), ' · ')

impRule.label: Imported repeat rule
impRule.compute: =!(item.impRuleText.matches(r'^FREQ=(DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY)(;(INTERVAL|COUNT|UNTIL|BYDAY|BYMONTHDAY|BYMONTH|WKST|DTSTART)=[A-Z0-9,+-]+)*$') && !item.impRuleText.matches(r'INTERVAL=0+(;|$)') && !(contains(item.impRuleText, 'COUNT=') && contains(item.impRuleText, 'UNTIL=')) && !(!contains(item.impRuleText, 'FREQ=MONTHLY') && !contains(item.impRuleText, 'FREQ=YEARLY') && item.impRuleText.matches(r'BYDAY=[^;]*[0-9]')) && !(contains(item.impRuleText, 'FREQ=WEEKLY') && contains(item.impRuleText, 'BYMONTHDAY'))) ? '' : contains(item.impRuleText, 'DTSTART=') ? item.impRuleText : item.impRuleText + ';DTSTART=' + replace(string(coalesce(item.impDay, today())), '-', '')

impDue.label: Imported due date (final)
impDue.compute: =has(item.impDay) ? item.impDay : item.impRule != '' ? (occursOn(item.impRule, today()) ? today() : nextOccurrence(item.impRule, today())) : null

impLeftover.label: Imported date that could not be read

empty.title: All done for today
empty.body: Nothing is due or overdue. Tap + to add a task for today, or plan ahead under Upcoming.

empty.title: Nothing planned
empty.body: Give a task a due date and it shows up here, grouped by day.

empty.title: Inbox is empty
empty.body: Jot down anything here, then give it a date or move it to a list.

empty.title: No lists yet
empty.body: Make a list for work, home, shopping or a trip.

empty.title: Nothing open in this list
empty.body: Add a task, or give one a due date to see it under Today and Upcoming too.

empty.title: Nothing open
empty.body: Every task you add, in any list, shows up here until it is done.

empty.title: No completed tasks
empty.body: Ticked-off tasks rest here, so you can bring one back if you need it.

streakStat.label: Streak
streakStat.caption: Days in a row with a task done

progressNote.text: Every completion counts, including each round of a repeating task. Deleting completed tasks keeps these numbers.

irIntro.text: These rows were left out, with the reason for each:

steps.title: =t('moveOverdue', {'n': size(q.overdue)})
steps.body: Their time of day stays as it is.

steps.title: =t('clearDone', {'n': size(q.completed)})
steps.body: They can’t be restored afterwards. Your progress numbers stay.

args.title: =args.task.title
args.body: =join([has(args.task.dueTime) ? 'Due ' + coalesce(formatDate(args.task.dueTime, 'jm'), '') : 'Due today', coalesce(args.task.list.name, 'Inbox'), size(args.task.steps) > 0 ? t('stepsDone', {'done': args.task.stepsDone, 'total': size(args.task.steps)}) : ''].filter(s, s != ''), ' · ')

set.notes: =args.task.impLeftover != '' ? substring(coalesce(args.task.notes, '') + (has(args.task.notes) ? '\n\n' : '') + 'Date or repeat from the imported file: ' + coalesce(args.task.impLeftover, ''), 0, 5000) : args.task.notes

dueReminder.at: =!has(item.due) ? null : item.snoozedUntil > datetime(item.due, coalesce(item.dueTime, settings.dayReminderAt)) ? item.snoozedUntil : datetime(item.due, coalesce(item.dueTime, settings.dayReminderAt))
